Cell.Text: I was thinking about that place we recently cleared...
Is there something you want to talk about?
Yeah, actually. I heard you've dealt with some source of skooma recently?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaTopic: What's on your mind?

Cell.Text: Where was skooma dealers and this wolf pit fights.
I wonder where you herad about it, but yes, thats true.
I was thinking about that place... is it Crackslane cavern? With wolf pit fights?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA1: Which one?

Cell.Text: Then I was looking at those fighting wolves I had one idea. | It might seem strange to you, but hear me out.
Cragslane, yeah, there was a pit fight.
Right, I thought about those fighting wolves I had one idea. | It might seem strange to you, but hear me out.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA2: Oh, yeah. That do you wish to discuss?

Cell.Text: Well, it's about pit fight again, but with more... interesting outcomes. | How to explain it... | Oh, well, let me tell straight. | What if it will be a place for dogs fight over to reveal the most strong and dominant ones for... | The right to mate with women?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA3: Very little can seem strange for me at this time. Tell me about it.

Cell.Text: Yeah, that might be pretty rough. | We can avoid too brutal fights and keep dogs from hurting each other too much though.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA4: Wow, that's really... interesting idea. But then strongest one wins other... Well, dies? Does it worth dogs to suffer?

Cell.Text: Mmm... Maybe it may be even hotter.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA5: You know, that might be pretty hot show. I mean, we could make real show from it. I even have some thoughts about it.

Cell.Text: *Jiggles* Exactly my thoughts. | Ah, if only it become real.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA6: Yeah, if dogs will mate with girls right on public after fight.

Cell.Text: And we know such people...
And we know such people, at least one of them.
[S] Surely we could find such people.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA7: I think we could make it real. We just need some help, preferably from like-minded people.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Yes! Let's do it.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_MariasIdeaA8: Well, what would you say? Shall we start preparations?

Cell.Text: Sure, what's up?
By the way, I have one more thing to ask.
Sure, what's up?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferTopic: Hello, Elara, have a moment?

Cell.Text: Tell me about it.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA1: We have one idea here, and thought maybe you could help us with it.

Cell.Text: That's... interesting idea. But even with such precautions and concern for the safety of the dogs I still worry about their safety. | However I think I like how it sounds after all. | Where did you say you would like to place it?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA2: (Describe idea about dog arena)

Cell.Text: A cave? You think it would be appropriate place for... | Well, I mean surely it would be appropriate for pit fight, but for visitors? | And I just thought, who but the bandits will be visiting such place? | There are more questions every minute.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA3: At Cragslane cavern, cave in Eastmarch, just south of Windhelm.

Cell.Text: Hmm... Well, if we succeed with that idea this place would be a great source of inspiration for my stories. | Ah, all right, count me in. I'll help you.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA4: Yeah, but I think we can handle it. And that's why we need help.

Cell.Text: Well, you thank me after our place will be ready and operational. | I wonder what will come of it. | I'll move there to see what we can do.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA5: Great! Thank you, Elara.

Cell.Text: [S] G|Later then.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_ElaraOfferA6: All right, I'll meet you there.

Cell.Text: Of course, what can I do for you?
There's one more thing I would like to ask...
Of course, what can I do for you?

Cell.Text: All right, let's hear it.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA1: We have one idea here, and thought maybe you could help us with it.

Cell.Text: Oh, wow, would be such place legal?

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA2: (Describe idea about dog arena)

Cell.Text: If we show it for bandits, yes. But if normal people will... | On the second thought no normal people will go there, only who might be really interested in such show and... services. | So yeah, I think we might be good.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA3: Well, before there was real bloody wolf pit fights, and nobody raided it. So I think we'll be good as well.

Cell.Text: Well I... with that I'll be able to try some really dirty things with real dogs.... | And utilize my familiar? | Yeah, I think I'm interested in this. I'll help you.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA4: So, could you be interested in this dog arena?

Cell.Text: I think I can handle this, I have atronachs after all.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA5: Cool, it might be difficult way to Cragslane from here, would you like me help you?

Cell.Text: [S] G|Yes, I'll hit the road now.

Node.Caption: lope_DogArena_Start_AsterOfferA6: All right, we'll meet there then?

Cell.Text: Yeah, do you need something?
There's one more thing I would like to ask...
Yeah, do you need something?
